thread:
Carla (AE): quick sync 0  Customer wants to move POC -> PO. They submitted a PO from the Czech holding but insist the UK trading entity sign. Also attached a DPA redline asking for HSM attestation and VAT-exempt treatment. Need legal, security, finance on POA, invoicing mapping, and whether we can deliver attestation.

Ben (Legal): paste their redline? if they make attestation a condition precedent to payment it's risky. Also we need explicit POA if signer differs from billing/payor. Acceptable POA: notarized POA, eIDAS advanced certificate, or corporate board resolution + government ID.

Carla (AE): snippet: 

```
DPA Sec 3.7: "Provider shall provide a signed HSM attestation within 10 business days of execution. Failure to provide attestation permits Customer to withhold payment until provided."
```

Ivy (Security): cannot commit to 10 business days for attestation. We can provide HSM attestation for Private or Dedicated deployments under a scoped SOW; timeline realistically 30-60 days depending on ops queue. Hosted tier does not include third-party HSM attestations.

Marco (FinOps): invoice mapping: if Czech holding issues PO but UK entity signs, we require a written payer mapping annex showing which legal entity will be invoiced and VAT handling. For VAT-exempt, we need the payer's VAT registration number. PO number required to bind invoice in our system. Net30 default unless they request otherwise.

Ben (Legal): propose edits: (1) strike payment-withholding language, (2) add "Provider will use commercially reasonable efforts to provide a scoped HSM attestation for Dedicated/Private deployments; timeline and any fees to be set forth in a mutually executed SOW; Hosted plans excluded." (3) add POA annex referencing acceptable proofs and a 14-day cure for missing POA before cancellation.

Carla (AE): I'll push that language. I'll ask procurement for: PO#, VAT reg number, which entity will pay, and an attached POA (notarized or eIDAS). I'll also ask whether they can accept an SOW for attestation and a 30-45 day window.

esig-bot: Envelope created (env_0xFA9) for Order Form + Addendum  awaiting signatures.

Ivy (Security): flagging product-ops: if they confirm Dedicated/BYO-HSM and SOW, we'll need to open a runbook and schedule attestation slot. Likely 30-60 days.

Marco (FinOps): once PO# and payer entity confirmed, finance will issue the invoice mapping. If they want split billing across entities, have them complete our billing annex template.

Ben (Legal): thanks. When you get the POA, forward it here and I'll finalize the addendum. If procurement insists on DocuSign only, we must get a certified POA PDF attached.

Carla (AE): pinging procurement off-thread now. Will update the thread with PO# and POA scan when it arrives. :thumbsup:
